project_type: Mock test generation system for J&K Police Constable (Executive/Armed/IRP/SDRF) exam prep
language: JSON (test files), Python (build/record/validate scripts), Markdown (study plan/steering)
test_framework: python3 mock-tests/_validate.py <file> checks each test; python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py <N> records it
verification_instructions: After generating each test JSON, run python3 mock-tests/_validate.py on it (checks 4 unique options, sequential ids, correctAnswer membership, explanation length, matching line format, A-R option set, section letters A-E, answer-key balance, and the 25:25:10:25:15 spread on mixed tests). Then run python3 mock-tests/_record_test.py <N> from the repo root; it appends fingerprints to history shards and updates config.json, manifest.json and STUDY_PLAN.md.
snapshot_or_generated_files: mock-tests/tests/*.json are generated test files. mock-tests/history/*.json, mock-tests/config.json, mock-tests/manifest.json, and STUDY_PLAN.md are updated by _record_test.py. STUDY_PLAN.md, manifest.json, config.json and the empty history shards are produced by _build_plan.py.
setup_instructions: No setup needed. Python 3 standard library only.
environment_constraints: No network needed for test generation. Tests are generated as JSON content by the AI agent itself.
contribution_requirements: Follow .kiro/steering/mock-test-prompt-constable.md exactly for question format, type counts, difficulty distribution, 10+2 level calibration, and anti-duplication rules. Section A (General English) must NOT contain comprehension passages, cloze passages, para jumbles or narration items — they are not in the Constable syllabus.
key_patterns: Each test is a JSON file with subject, topic, total_questions, and a questions array. Each question has id (string '1'..'N'), subject (A-E), questionText (\n for line breaks), options (exactly 4), correctAnswer (byte-identical copy of one option), explanation (why correct + why each of the other three is wrong). Question types must follow the Section 1 count table. Mixed/full tests follow the 25:25:10:25:15 section ratio. History shards store normalized stems to prevent duplicates.
directory_structure: Root: README.md, STUDY_PLAN.md, syllabus_constable.md, mock-tests/. mock-tests/: config.json, manifest.json, _build_plan.py, _validate.py, _record_test.py, _normalize.py, tests/ (generated test JSONs), history/ (A-E.json fingerprint shards). .kiro/steering/ has the generation prompt.
